profile.headline: My Python code is faster than your C++. But I also write C++.
profile.summary: Raquel has worked for 10 years professionally — starting with multi-platform C++ apps, then C#/SQL, then front-end React/Redux in 2015-2018, and lately managing a JFrog Artifactory/Xray cluster and doing React, Python and Kotlin projects running in Docker containers on RHEL / SELinux.
